instruction: Cinematic film still, medium shot. Indoors by a window with books and roses, an older blonde woman (R1) in a beige shirt and pants sits on the left, looking down slightly while speaking. On the right, a bearded man (R2) in a beige shirt and pants sits in an armchair, looking at her attentively. They hold hands warmly. Soft natural light fills the room, creating a gentle, intimate mood with warm neutral tones.
